curated-gf-playwrite-is-gf-josefin-slab: Josefin Slab reads low and bookish, lofty capitals over a small lowercase, with no swells to slow the eye. Playwrite IS earns its keep big and brief (a dear diary cover, say).
curated-gf-playwrite-is-guides-gf-rhodiu: Inviting and relaxed, Playwrite IS Guides writes in tube-like strokes. Rhodium Libre, with its lifted brush ends, keeps paragraphs moving at a steady, traditional pace, workout challenge graphic or not.
curated-gf-playwrite-it-moderna-guides-g: Squat, hand-drawn, casual: that's Playwrite IT Moderna Guides. Let Sanchez run a little larger than usual, since its dignified serif has a c opened like calipers (say, for custom embroidery patches).
curated-gf-playwrite-it-trad-gf-kotta-on: Kotta One brings a sign-painter's single-stroke look, with a squat lowercase beneath long ascenders and an open-bowled a. And Playwrite IT Trad scatters its letters like seeds, which suits brief bursts of text.
curated-gf-playwrite-no-gf-oxygen-mono: Playwrite NO's loose, gaping c sets the tone, with bowls drawn at stem thickness and a casual hand. Give Oxygen Mono a modest size, say, for a punk gig flyer.
curated-gf-playwrite-nz-basic-gf-prata: Constant-width strokes with open jaws give Playwrite NZ Basic its friendly, hand-written ease. Prata supplies the authority through sudden stem-to-hairline drops, and it's best for brief lines (hair accessories, say).
curated-gf-playwrite-pe-gf-gulzar: Relaxed and personal, Playwrite PE lets each glyph stand apart. The heading holds a steady pen pressure, while Gulzar does its best work in the gentle swelling of each round letter.
curated-gf-playwrite-pl-gf-datatype: Datatype sets typewriter-like, fixed-width letters with generous curve gaps, giving a structured, precise counterpoint to the hand-drawn heading. Playwrite PL against rigid type is the draw (say, a song lyric sheet).
curated-gf-playwrite-ro-guides-gf-im-fel: IM Fell Great Primer SC reads bookish and editorial, its stroke contrast understated (a junk journal would suit it). Playwrite RO Guides loosens things, its stepping-stone letters best kept brief.
curated-gf-playwrite-sk-gf-jura: Jura reads clean and neutral, its s curves opening wide at both ends. Give it a modest size beside Playwrite SK, whose tiny bowls and fat crossbars already carry plenty of personality.
